description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeTerminationAPITest' for testing the 'EmployeeTerminationAPI' endpoints in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes tests for CRUD operations, validation rules, and exception handling related to employee termination records.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeTerminationAPI, testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and exception handling related to employee termination records in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing employee termination records from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete functionality of EmployeeTerminationAPI, including successful deletion and handling of non-existent records.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for deleting an employee termination record.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getAll method is not implemented and raises the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for fetching all employee termination records.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee termination record, including success and not found scenarios.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for fetching a single employee termination record.

methods.name: testCreateWithRecordNotFound
methods.description: Ensures creating a termination record fails if the employee does not exist.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new employee termination record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the creation input validation rules.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee termination record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the update input validation rules.
